evidence_type: aggregate-only QVoice heartbeat voluntary attrition trailing 12 months through August 2026

outcome_contract.label: Trailing 12-month voluntary attrition through August 2026
outcome_contract.target: At least one term_type exactly VOLUNTARY inside the August trailing-12-month window.
outcome_contract.population: worker_type='Employee'; employee_type='Regular'; active_status=1 at the pre-wave snapshot.
outcome_contract.grain: Distinct employee in the QVoice heartbeat-eligible group.

heartbeat_definition.sign_rule: +1 when item > personal mean; 0 when item = personal mean; -1 when item < personal mean.
heartbeat_definition.missing_rule: Missing or invalid item values are not converted to 0 and are excluded from that item's denominator.
heartbeat_definition.ranking_rule: Top five items by upvote_percent and downvote_percent among items with n >= 30.
heartbeat_definition.absolute_context: Favorable means scale response 4 or 5 among the same valid item denominator.

heartbeat_population.grain: Distinct employee at the pre-Jan-2026 monthly snapshot
